correctionNote: Run 3.1 corrects Run 3 (travis-full-run3-20261025) with no new source capture. County group: every CAR is Run 3's, byte for byte (same CIDs): structure.roof_date is the TCAD built year; owner names are parsed into persons and companies linked by person_has_property and company_has_property; tenure is read from dated sales and TCAD transfer deeds; accounts without a GIS point take a City of Austin address point only on a unique exact match. Property Improvement group (published scope: roofing-classified, decided-status permits only, 15025 rows of 2008095 permits linked to a TCAD account) rebuilt from the same Query DB rows: all 15025 permit records are unchanged; 413 permits that print no contractor company but print a contractor person now carry that name as the contractor company's name, as printed on the permit and not verified (PO 2026-10-26, ERR-72), so 4552 published permits name a contractor. The contractor_* coverage counts are now matched against the loaded Comptroller registry (ERR-73); no per-permit resolution is published. Tables (contract v1.2, ERR-74, PO 2026-10-26): every table of both groups is re-exported from these CARs by elephant-cli export-tables 44bb182 with one patch (pipeline/publish/patches/elephant-cli-export-oneof.patch, sha256 70dfadbe842933f165998860c6c32d80d1a77e4c72243de153d957413abff7c8; it turns dist/services/tables-export.service.js sha256 af8c9c05f1d33872c6e1a0b60afbcf10ae2a93100109395fc2d342de3948207b into sha256 4b5e6a4a28f27a2bb672e80baec2b11c0e5a6798e782bf755ddfeefaee6258fb): a top-level oneOf class (address) gets the union of its branches' properties as columns, so the address table now carries unnormalized_address, city_name, state_code, postal_code and the other address fields. Checked row for row against Run 3 (specs/011-publish-and-runs/run3-1/table-compare.md): every County table holds exactly Run 3's rows (address on its Run 3 columns); the Property Improvement tables hold Run 3's rows plus the 413 contractor companies and links above, and 327 properties rows whose data-group root changed with them. County part bytes and CIDs change only because export-tables cuts row groups by the pending bytes of all tables together.
